source.citation: Robie, R.A., and Hemingway, B.S. (1995), Thermodynamic properties of minerals and related substances at 298.15 K and 1 bar (10^5 pascals) pressure and at higher temperatures, U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 2131.
source.transcription: Printed formation tables transcribed from the official PDF. Each row retains its printed page, temperature, and PDF text line locator.

phases.printed_phase_description: α-Ca₂SiO₄: Monoclinic crystals 298.15 to 1000 K. Bredigite (α′) is the stable modification of Ca₂SiO₄ between 970 and 1710 K. α-crystals 1710 to 1800 K.
KAlSiO₄: Hexagonal crystals 298.15 to 810 K. High kaliophillite 810 to 1800 K.
Mn₂SiO₄: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 1524 K. Tephroite melts incongruently at 1524 K.
LiAlSi2O6: Tetragonal crystals 298.15 to 1700 K. Melting point is 1696 K.
BaCO₃: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 1079 K; tetragonal crystals 1079 to 1241 K; cubic crystals 1241 to 1600 K.
FeS₂: Cubic crystals 298.15 to 1000 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur.
FeS₂: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 700 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur.
Cu₂S: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 376 K; hexagonal crystals 376 to 710 K; cubic crystals 710 to melting point 1403 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur.

CuFeS₂: Tetragonal crystals 298.15 to 820 K; tetragonal crystals 820 to 930 K; cubic crystals 930 to 1200 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur. Above 820 K, the phase is called ISS (intermediate solid solution).
Cu₅FeS₄: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 470 K; cubic crystals 470 to 535 K; cubic crystals 535 to 1200 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur.
CaTiO3: Orthorhombic crystals 1530 K; cubic crystals 1530 to 1800 K.
Ag: Face-centered cubic crystals 298.15 to melting point 1234.9 K.
β-crystals (body-centered cubic): 1650 to melting point 2023 K.
γ-crystals (body-centered cubic) 1049 to melting point 1408 K.
KNO₃: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 401 K; rhombohedral crystals 401 to 610 K; liquid 610 to 700 K.
KNO₃: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 401 K; rhombohedral crystals 401 to 610 K; liquid 610 to 700 K.
NaNO₃: α-crystals 298.15 to 549.2 K. β-crystals 549.2 to 583.2 K. Liquid 583.2 to 700 K.
SnS: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 875 K; cubic crystals 875 to melting point 1153 K. Liquid 1153 to 1300 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur.
SnS: Orthorhombic crystals 298.15 to 875 K; cubic crystals 875 to melting point 1153 K. Liquid 1153 to 1300 K. Reference state for sulfur is orthorhombic sulfur.
As: Rhombohedral crystals 298.15 to sublimation point 875 K. Ideal tetratomic gas 875 to 1800 K.
Sb: Rhombohedral crystals 298.15 to melting point 904 K. Liquid 904 to 1800 K.
Sn: Crystals 298.15 to melting point 505.1 K. Liquid 501 to 1800 K.
Te: Crystals 298.15 to melting point 723 K. Liquid 723 to boiling point 1261 K. Ideal diatomic gas 1261 to 1800 K.
